Text: The most important warning with metoprolol is not to stop it suddenly. Stopping a beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain and, in some cases, a heart attack. If your treatment needs to stop, your prescriber will lower the dose gradually over 1 to 2 weeks and watch how you respond. This applies even if you only take metoprolol for blood pressure, because heart disease is common and is not always known about.
Talk to your care team before starting metoprolol if any of these apply to you.
- Asthma or other breathing problems. Beta blockers can tighten the airways. Metoprolol is used in people with these conditions only when other treatments are not suitable, at the lowest possible dose, with a reliever inhaler on hand.
- Heart failure. Heart failure can get worse while the dose is being increased. Tell your doctor about weight gain or increasing breathlessness.
- A slow heart rate or a conduction problem in the heart. This includes first-degree heart block, sinus node problems, and Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome. Your heart rate should be monitored.
Triplet: ["metoprolol", "has risk in", "weight gain"]

The relation 'has risk in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may worsen or cause the condition specified by the object entity when used in individuals with that condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.
